properties.name: Al Faheem Meat Exports Pvt. Ltd.
properties.source_name: Allahabad High Court, Al Faheem Meat Exports vs State of UP (2006); Swarajya ground report (2019)
properties.notes: Petitioner in the 2006 case over the old municipal slaughterhouse on Hapur Road, Meerut, whose waste went into the drains feeding the Kali Nadi. The old slaughterhouse was demolished in 2012; whether Al Faheem still operates at this site is NOT verified. Plotted in the Hapur Road area on the Odean course - exact plant site not published.

properties.name: Modi Distillery (Modi Industries Ltd)
properties.source_name: Supreme Court of India, UPPCB vs Modi Distillery (1987)
properties.notes: The judgment records the distillery discharging 'highly noxious and polluted trade effluents into the Kali River through the Kadrabad Drain'. 1987 case - current operating status NOT verified. Plotted at Modinagar town (exact plant site not published).

properties.name: Modi Sugar Mill, Modinagar
properties.effluent_source: UPPCB consented treated-effluent discharge limit (450 KLD), per NGT joint committee report 2022 - a permitted limit, not a measured discharge
properties.source_name: National Green Tribunal OA 418/2021 & 447/2021, joint committee report (2022)
properties.notes: Sugar mill (5000 TCD), ETP capacity 1000 KLD. Discharge route into the Kadrabad Drain is NOT stated in the NGT report - linkage is by location (Modinagar, in the drain's catchment), not a published outfall map. Plotted at Modinagar town.

properties.name: Modinagar Paper Mills Ltd
properties.source_name: ETP performance study, Modinagar Paper Mills Ltd (2016)
properties.notes: Paper mill with ETP (2016 study: final discharge BOD 24 mg/l). Effluent volume not published. Discharge route into the Kadrabad Drain NOT stated - linkage by location (Modinagar catchment) only. Plotted at Modinagar town.

properties.name: Rana Sugar Ltd (Unit-3), Belwara, Manpur
properties.source_name: UPPCB, Action Plan for Restoration of Polluted Stretch of River Ramganga, Moradabad to Kannauj
properties.notes: Named in the action plan (environmental compensation Rs 1.5 lakh imposed; prosecution initiated). The plan says the 121 catchment industries discharge through 12 drains but does not map unit to drain in the excerpt consulted - assigned to the traced Moradabad city drain by catchment, NOT confirmed. Plotted at Moradabad town (Belwara/Manpur site not published).

properties.name: Rana Sugar Ltd (Unit-4), Karimganj, Shahabad
properties.source_name: UPPCB, Action Plan for Restoration of Polluted Stretch of River Ramganga, Moradabad to Kannauj
properties.notes: Named in the action plan (environmental compensation Rs 1 lakh imposed). Same catchment caveat as Unit-3: unit-to-drain mapping not stated in the excerpt. Plotted at Shahabad, Rampur (Karimganj site not published).

properties.name: Jajmau CETP (old, 36 MLD)
properties.effluent_source: Tannery share of the 36 MLD plant (9 MLD tannery + 27 MLD sewage), PIB 2017; UP Jal Jeevan Mission portal
properties.source_name: PIB (CPCB GPI data, 2017); UP JJM / Namami Gange STP list; NGT OA 985/2019 (Jajmau tanneries)
properties.notes: NOT on a traced drain: the Jajmau CETP discharges treated effluent directly to the Ganga. Included as basin context because it is the largest tannery cluster in the basin (~400 tanneries in ~7.4 sq km, UPPCB to NGT 2023). 9.0 MLD is the tannery wastewater share, not the plant's total flow (36 MLD incl. sewage). Plotted at Jajmau, Kanpur (exact plant site not published).

properties.name: Jajmau CETP (new, 20 MLD, tannery only)
properties.effluent_source: Design capacity (20 MLD, tannery effluent only) - NOT a measured discharge
properties.source_name: PIB (2018 announcement, Rs 554 cr); NGT CPCB reply Jan 2025 (commissioned Aug 2024)
properties.notes: NOT on a traced drain: discharges to the Ganga via a 25 km dedicated conveyance system. 20 MLD is design capacity. Plotted next to the old CETP at Jajmau (exact site not published).

properties.name: Agarpara Jute Mills Ltd
properties.effluent_source: WBPCB consent to operate (2024): max 240 KLD mixed wastewater to municipal drain after treatment - a permitted limit, not a measured discharge
properties.source_name: West Bengal Pollution Control Board, Consent to Operate WBPCB/4390133/2023 (26 Nov 2024)
properties.notes: NOT on a traced drain: the CTO says discharge to 'Municipal Drain' without naming it; the mill is at 28 B.T. Road, Kamarhati, beside the traced Kamarhati Drain @ Jute Mill (rank 24, just outside the top 20) - the receiving drain is not confirmed, so drain_name is left blank. Plotted at Kamarhati town.

properties.name: Multiwal Pulp and Board Mills (P) Ltd
properties.source_name: NGT proceedings (Kashipur paper units); UPPCB Ramganga Action Plan (Kashipur paper cluster discharges via the Dhela)
properties.notes: Paper mill, Bazpur Road, Kashipur. Discharges via the Dhela River into the Ramganga - the Dhela is NOT a traced drain, so drain_name records the tributary. Plotted at Kashipur town (exact plant site not published).

properties.name: Cheema Papers Ltd
properties.source_name: NGT proceedings (Kashipur paper units); UPPCB Ramganga Action Plan
properties.notes: Paper mill, 9 km stone Bazpur Road, Kashipur. Same Dhela caveat as Multiwal. Plotted at Kashipur town.

properties.name: Multiwal Duplex Pvt. Ltd
properties.source_name: Uttarakhand EPPCB direction under s.33(A) Water Act (2018); NGT proceedings
properties.notes: Duplex board unit (waste paper, 900 MT/month), Vill. Gangapur Gusain, Kundeshwari Road, Kashipur. Consent refused Dec 2017 for non-compliance. Same Dhela caveat. Plotted at Kashipur town.

properties.name: Kashi Vishwanath Textile Mill Ltd
properties.source_name: NGT proceedings (Kashipur industrial units list)
properties.notes: Textile mill, 5th km stone Ramnagar Road, Kashipur. Same Dhela caveat. Plotted at Kashipur town.
